import_with_vsphere_only.name: Import to VCF

notices.title: Shared NSX Manager Across vCenters
bullets: If a shared NSX Manager is selected during the import process, the vSphere version must align with the NSX version in use.
NSX 4.2.x supports vSphere 8 — no vCenter upgrade is required before import. NSX 9.1 requires vSphere 9.1 — the vCenter being imported must be upgraded to 9.1 before proceeding.
It is recommended to import all vCenters connected to a shared NSX Manager before upgrading the shared NSX Manager instance.

notices.title: IP Requirements
bullets: A License Hub must be deployed within your environment if does not already exist, or AVI and NSX must have outbound internet access for direct license validation.
If internet access is not available, deploy a License Hub before proceeding.
A License Hub instance requires a single subnet with two separate IP pools: one for the controller and worker nodes, and another for License Hub services.
Node IP pool: 4 contiguous IP addresses
Service IP pool: 4 contiguous IP addresses
